decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter fiat users' email-based access to referrals, tickets, or prizes.
The provider change applies to the fiat on-ramp integration and does not change the primary NFT mint behavior represented by this Requirement.
Coinbase Commerce replaces Stripe for the fiat on-ramp, while Brevo remains the transactional email provider.
The fiat payment-provider switch does not change SIWE authentication for crypto mint and transfer flows.
The source changes only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not change email or magic-link dashboard authentication.
Secondary-sale royalty funding and ticket rules are independent of the provider used for fiat on-ramp payments.
The payment-provider switch does not change which referral, ticket, and prize data the dashboard must display.
Replacing Stripe with Coinbase Commerce does not change the unauthenticated access mode or exposed public data.
The source does not change the automatic $5 commission generated by code-based referral mints.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision does not change the requirement to deploy the smart-contract system on Base.
The provider switch does not alter the Small Block prize amounts, draw trigger, winner count, or pool funding rules.
